interpretation.fitReadbackAvoidance: No benefit observed: the complete CPU readback/fit/reupload round trip is faster at both measured sizes.
interpretation.simulationScaling: One shared factor removes replicate-duplicated conditioning, but sequential storage Cholesky remains cubic and costs146.2ms at128+128 on this device.
interpretation.indexedNaturalNeighbor: Cavity timings exclude caller-provided index construction and containing-triangle location; upload measured separately.
interpretation.timestamps: CPU encode/submit/completion; GPU timestamps remain null.
